senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; עָזַר; cmp. גִּזְרָה)enclosure, esp. Temple court.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:4">Midd. I, 4</cite> <he>שבעה שערים היו בע׳</he> the Temple court had seven gates.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:5">Ib. II, 5</cite> <he>עֶזְרַת הנשים</he> the women’s compartment in the Temple court; <he>עזרת ישראל</he> the men’s compartment (for non-priests). Ib. 6 <he>כל הע׳ וכ׳</he> the whole ʿĂzarah was one hundred and seventy five cubits long &c.; a. v. fr.—<he>ספר הע׳</he> the copy of the Torah used in the Temple court.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:4">M. Kat. III, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Moed Katan 18b">18ᵇ</cite>) <he>ספר הע׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="P00426"><he>עזרא</he></cite> the copy deposited by Ezra).
